sn45.180:1.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ||
sn45.180:1.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāganirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || ||
sn45.180:1.8: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānaṃ samyojanānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ayam a- amaggo bhāvetabbo ti || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī || la || || 18.
sn45.180:2.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam abhiññaya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya a- a- maggo bhāvetabbo ||
sn45.180:2.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti rāgavinaya- dosavinaya- mohavinayapariyosānam ||
sn45.180:2.10: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānam abhiññāya parikkhāya pahānāya ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || ||
